title: Whole Neck Basin Open Hood and Hamper Preparation Bay
description: One static salon wash-and-dry equipment-preparation bay, one scene zero new models. The complete original neck-recess pedestal basin stands at the rear-left floor station, retaining its deep empty bowl and tap exterior. The whole open-hood dryer stands independently rear-right on its original five-branch caster base, with no chair or head placed beneath the hood. The entire empty folded-fabric hamper cart is parked forward-right beyond both complete equipment envelopes, leaving a visible empty central/front area. All original buffers, normals, material dictionaries, hierarchy and original units remain unchanged; only whole translations and a finite floor are new. Unlike the facing-chair/mirror salon scene this groups washing/drying floor equipment and empty textile collection with no styling chair, mirror or tool tabletop. Unlike the public basin/hand-bay station this retains the complete tall open hood and mobile fabric receptacle, not a hand-appliance cubicle. No person, towels, hair, water, pipe or electrical connections, treatment, heating, airflow, sanitation, usability, neck/head fit, load, access or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
